edges.label: Send message over HTTPS using the AWS SDK with a VPC endpoint

steps.caption: The browser connects to the nearest CloudFront edge over HTTPS.
CloudFront forwards the dynamic request to the load balancer.
The load balancer picks pod A. Pod B takes the next request.
Pod A checks the session in Redis.
Pod A queries the primary database. Writes grow the database over time.
Pod B drops a notification on the queue and returns to the customer immediately.
A second notification joins the queue.
The worker long-polls the queue and takes the oldest message.
The worker hands the message to SES for delivery.
